text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... So sleepy.
Japanese class first period is gonna be rough...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Umm... G-Good m...
Brian-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ——Hey! Greet people properly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Talk about showing no courtesy to a classmate.
...So anyway, mornin'!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ah, good morning, Hishiama-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's practically the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Like hell it's the same! It's 'cause you're like that that everyone gets intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ha, haha... A-As expected of Hishiama-chan.
Sharp as ever today.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Well then, since today is the ——th... let's see.
B-Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Umm, perhaps you're tired from training! Then this time, someone else——

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, the teacher called on you!
Get up there and solve it already!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. What a pain.
Ama-san, you go instead.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't be ridiculous! There's no way I can solve an advanced problem like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that really something to say with such pride...?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
S-She's so tough... in so many ways.
That's our Hishiama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
——After school.
While stopping by the training grounds to study coaching techniques, I witnessed an unbelievable sight.
choice_data_list: That Hishi Amazon——lost by a huge margin?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: ...Is Hishiama-chan gonna be okay? No matter how close they are, losing by that much has gotta hurt...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's gotta take a toll on her mentally, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
DAMN ITTTTT!!
It's been ages since I suffered such a crushing defeaaat!!
choice_data_list: (...Wait, she's not nearly as depressed as I thought?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Made my move too early, huh...
Thought it was a pretty solid strategy, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Today's attempt was a failure, Ama-san.
You didn't put up a challenge at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Kgh...! You sure don't mince words~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're right on the mark.
My bad for givin' ya such a half-baked showdown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A side dish from tomorrow's bento will do as an apology.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't you mean a side dish is what you "want"?
...Sheesh, you really are something else.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, they're completely back to normal.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Not being discouraged even after that is amazing.
Really amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Though from Brian-san's perspective, having someone like Hishiama-chan around might be a relief.
Winning and having things turn awkward happens pretty often, after all.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why they get along so well?
...Come to think of it, Brian-san only attaches '-san' to Ama-chan's name.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right...! Is it really because they're exceptionally close? Or is there some specific reason for it?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Wanna try asking Ama-chan next time? Maybe there's some dramatic story behind it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright! Now that that's settled, how about another round!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Pass. I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remaining equals whether they won or lost.
Watching their relationship unfold, that feeling resonated deeply within me.
